PreInvocation.command: thurbox-cli session signal --state working >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo '{}'

hooks.command: thurbox-cli session signal --state blocked >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo '{"decision": "allow"}'
thurbox-cli session signal --state working >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo '{}'

Stop.command: thurbox-cli session signal --state done >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo '{}'
